reader.requirement: A directly or indirectly contained program is compiled as a separate program (its own data, procedure names, declaratives and state) that may also reference the container's global data, files and reports and the container's Configuration Section entries.

edition-consulted.switches: hands session.Edition to the unit's DataBinder (EditionContext): diagnostics wording and edition-gated clause checks; the inheritance seed (InheritStep.Seed) and InheritContainerGlobalData take no edition
below 2002 a data-description clause operand (ODO, KEY, RENAMES) takes no implicit qualifiers; not on the procedure-division reference path these rules govern

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|Cobol1985|Cobol85|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior' over InheritStep.cs, SymbolTable/SymbolTable.cs, SymbolTable.Reports.cs, SymbolTable.DataNameCandidates.cs, SymbolTable.Declarations.cs, SymbolTable.Files.cs, SymbolTable.IndexNames.cs, SymbolTable.ConditionNames.cs, ReportScope.cs and DataBinder.cs: TryResolve, TryResolveUnqualified, NearestDeclaring, NearestDeclaringData, NearestDeclaringConditions, NearerConditionNameHides, InheritGlobalSubtree and InheritReport consult no edition; the only hits are message citations (Edition.Edition.Cite), SumCounterOperand85 and ClauseOperandsTakeImplicitQualifiers
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f06_05 covers the nested structure; the probes add the container's Configuration Section, separate paragraph names and separate WORKING-STORAGE state

probes.printed: I X=INN E=1,25 K=1 / I HEX / I OTHER / I X=INN E=1,25 K=2 / I HEX / I OTHER / O X=OUT CNT=2
probes.expected: contained program has its own X, own paragraph P-OTHER and its own last-used state (K=2), and reaches the container's GLOBAL CNT and its Configuration Section (DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, CLASS HEXC)

probes.printed: COBOL1639 PERFORM 'I-PARA' (outer naming a contained program's paragraph); PERFORM 'O-PARA' and GO TO 'O-PARA' (contained naming the container's paragraph)
probes.expected: refused: paragraph-names are referenced only in the program that declares them (§1985:X.1.3.8)

probes.printed: I X=MID / I Y=INY / I YG=OUY / I XG=OUX / I Z=OUZ / I C=FALSE / I CCV=TRUE / J X=MID Z=OUZ / J C=FALSE / 3 X=OUX / 3 C=TRUE / O REC=IREC1 / O Y=NEW N=4 V=4AB**
probes.expected: B's own Y (GR3a); unqualified X and C in SCOPEI/SCOPEJ the middle program's (GR3b1), in SCOPE3 the outer's; Y OF G, X OF G, C OF CV and Z the one object qualification identifies (GR1, GR2); the global FD and its record written from the contained program; the ODO record and reference modification of a global group altered from the contained program

contained program reads unqualified LINE-COUNTER and PAGE-COUNTER OF R1 of the container's GLOBAL report (its only visible report), alters PAGE-COUNTER and sum counter T OF LN1, and the container sees the same registers

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.2.3.3 GR2  (python scripts/spec/cite.py --check "§1985:X.2.3.3 GR2" "considered in these specifications as a separate program")

reader.notes: The contained program keeps its own X, paragraph P-OTHER and last-used K across calls, cannot name the container's paragraphs or be named by it, and reaches the container's GLOBAL CNT, GLOBAL FD, GLOBAL report and its DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA and CLASS HEXC. The ConfigurationStep member read is Produce (the seed names Inherit).

refuter.evidence: Attacked the 1985-only arms of 'separate program ... may additionally reference certain resources defined in the containing program' (§1985:X.2.3.3 GR2) with §1985:VI.4.2 ('The Configuration Section must not be stated in a program which is contained directly or indirectly within another program'; 'The entries explicitly or implicitly stated in the Configuration Section of a program which contains other programs apply to each contained program'). cfg1.cob (contained program with its own CONFIGURATION SECTION, DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA) at --std 85: EXIT 65, 'cfg1.cob(10,8): error COBOL1643: a CONFIGURATION SECTION is specified in a program contained within another program' citing §1985:VI.4.2 (the later editions' form refused at 85). cfg2.cob (container: PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE IS REV, ALPHABET REV IS 'B' 'A', SYMBOLIC CHARACTERS STAR IS 43, CURRENCY SIGN IS 'Q'; contained program compares 'A' < 'B', edits PIC QQ9.99, moves STAR): EXIT 0, 'O A>=B / I A>=B / I M= Q5.00 / I S=*': the container's collating sequence, currency sign and symbolic character apply in the contained program. sep1.cob (container and contained program both declare section MAIN-S, paragraphs P-1 and PX and 01 K; CALL twice, CANCEL, CALL): 'O PX K=1 / I PX K=6 / I PX K=7 / I PX K=6': each PERFORM PX reaches its own program's paragraph, the contained program keeps its own last-used state and CANCEL restores its initial state. The reader's structref already covers cross-program procedure references. No probe overturned. Citations: OK §1985:X.2.3.3 GR2 ('may additionally reference certain resources defined in the containing program'); OK §1985:VI.4.2 ('The Configuration Section must not be stated in a program which is contained directly or indirectly within another program'); OK §1985:VI.4.2 ('apply to each contained program').
